lines.text: PARAGRAPH SHADING: the box of a paragraph runs from its first line or its later lines,
whichever begin further left, to its right indent. The shading passes the box by 1.5 points on
each side. A right rule draws the shading out to itself, and draws it as far beyond the left edge
where a left rule stands. A top or bottom rule runs to the outer edge of a side rule, and 1.5
points beyond the box on a side without one. Shading crosses the space between two
paragraphs whose boxes and borders are identical. Each sample states the extent of its
shading in W ord, in points from the left edge of the page, whose text runs from 72 to 540.
The rules of the samples that follow are 3 points wide and 4 points from the text.
